metadata.title: MÉMOIRE SUR LES ÉQUIVALENTS DES CORPS SIMPLES

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (popularized by Bodoni and Didot) common in 19th-century French printing.
